topics.name: Diffusion, flow, and Gaussian generative modeling
topics.summary: Image, video, climate, and 3D studies use diffusion or flow-based generators with geometric or temporal guidance. Conditioning, distillation, and latent-space controls improve fidelity, controllability, or reconstruction efficiency.

topics.name: Agent evaluation, planning, and tool use
topics.summary: These studies evaluate agents on video editing, CAD, coding, retrieval, and long-horizon interaction. Rubrics, execution traces, world rehearsal, and post-task critique expose failures in planning, tool selection, cost, and reliability.

topics.name: Document parsing and multimodal information extraction
topics.summary: Document and chart systems combine layout cues, visual features, schemas, and confidence estimates to turn pages into searchable fields. Benchmarks span scientific figures, financial documents, historical archives, and structured extraction pipelines.

topics.name: Education and human-centered AI
topics.summary: The papers connect AI systems with learning support, interaction design, biology education, and mixed-reality perception. They emphasize user goals, interpretable personalization, and measurable changes in human performance or experience.

topics.name: Wearable sensing and autonomous-system assurance
topics.summary: Low-power sensors and operational audits monitor stress, repetitive strain, and autonomous analysis quality. The shared emphasis is on continuous signals, detection limits, and feedback that can support safer decisions outside the laboratory.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and agent infrastructure
topics.summary: Multi-agent platforms address device orchestration, hospital workflows, networked digital twins, route coordination, and distributed security. Communication protocols, shared state, observability, and governance are treated as practical determinants of collective behavior.

topics.name: Optimization algorithms and fine-tuning systems
topics.summary: Optimization work spans nonsmooth solvers, stochastic variational inequalities, hardware training operations, and adaptive model tuning. The studies compare convergence, resource use, and operational safeguards when objectives or model components are changed.

topics.name: Vision-language grounding and multimodal perception
topics.summary: Vision-language models are tested for spatial reference, segmentation, figure reading, emotion, medical signals, and remote-sensing retrieval. Grounding losses, calibration, distillation, and test-time adaptation align visual evidence with decisions.

topics.name: Speech, audio, and multimodal search
topics.summary: Audio systems cover music mixing, guitar timbre, speech codecs, rural voice forms, transcription, and spoken-language assessment. Lightweight representations and annotated corpora support robust recognition, synthesis, and on-device search.

topics.name: Robustness, safety, and uncertainty in AI
topics.summary: The cluster studies deepfake detection, risk inference, factuality, anomaly resilience, selective trust, and evaluation gaps. Adversarial tests, conformal ideas, uncertainty measures, and layered safeguards reveal misleading confidence and benchmark scores.

topics.name: LLM alignment, personalization, and unlearning
topics.summary: Language-model adaptation is examined through dialect robustness, runtime guardrails, personalization, generated-text detection, medical transfer, and federated attacks. Steering and forgetting can improve behavior while also creating new failure modes.

topics.name: Information retrieval and evidence-grounded RAG
topics.summary: Retrieval systems combine embeddings, neuro-symbolic reasoning, time-series context, evidence selection, and taxonomy search. Evaluation focuses on grounding, ranking stability, budget-aware decisions, and resistance to poisoned or incomplete sources.

topics.name: Forecasting and temporal modeling
topics.summary: Forecasting papers model chaotic trajectories, multivariate dependencies, residual drift, biological time series, and demand or climate signals. They compare temporal context, cross-variable objectives, latent dynamics, and shift-aware validation.

topics.name: LLM training and data curation
topics.summary: Training studies examine influence estimation, continual updates, task selection, replay, and multimodal data quality. Curation and adaptation choices shape capability, forgetting, and reliability as much as architecture does.

topics.name: LLM reasoning, evaluation, and verification
topics.summary: Reasoning work measures multilingual compliance, factual consistency, chain faithfulness, authority, and self-correction. New tests and verifiers connect intermediate behavior to final outcomes instead of treating a single answer score as sufficient.

topics.name: LLM capability evaluation and benchmarking
topics.summary: Benchmark papers probe research synthesis, medical data, motion understanding, synthetic data, kernel generation, routing, and planning. Task-specific protocols expose contamination, hidden failure cases, and the gap between nominal accuracy and usefulness.

topics.name: Natural language understanding and text generation
topics.summary: Text-focused studies address discourse change, multilingual generation, structured language understanding, and topic-model evaluation. Datasets and controlled comparisons clarify how lexical variation, prompting, and task formulation affect model behavior.

topics.name: Robotic manipulation and dexterous control
topics.summary: Robotics papers learn contact, force, handover, teleoperation, surgical actions, soft actuators, and dexterous skills from vision, tactile signals, or world models. Active perception and predictive monitoring improve control under changing dynamics.

topics.name: Video understanding and generation
topics.summary: Video studies cover long-context streaming, action assessment, virtual try-on, frame interpolation, and generative world models. Temporal representations, latent alignment, and agent feedback preserve motion, identity, and task-relevant events.

topics.name: Grounded and verifiable language models
topics.summary: The papers connect language outputs to evidence, hidden-state signals, causal structure, and explicit stopping or abstention decisions. Hallucination tests and retrieval workflows make unsupported claims easier to detect.

topics.name: Robot navigation and embodied agents
topics.summary: Embodied systems combine visual-inertial sensing, map imagination, world models, traffic reasoning, social cost functions, and open-world navigation. Benchmarks highlight safety, memory, and adaptation beyond simulated success rates.

topics.name: Efficient inference, pruning, and compression
topics.summary: Efficiency methods reduce compute through token pruning, KV reuse, quantization, sparse routing, hardware search, and approximate inference. Experiments track tradeoffs among latency, memory, calibration, and task quality.

topics.name: Interpretability and representation analysis
topics.summary: Interpretability studies inspect hidden states, sparse features, representation geometry, and learning dynamics in language and multimodal models. Probes, mode decompositions, and interventions separate genuine structure from prompt- or metric-dependent artifacts.

topics.name: 3D vision and neural rendering
topics.summary: The group reconstructs scenes, points, surfaces, and views with Gaussian splats, radiance fields, pose estimation, and multi-view geometry. Structural priors and uncertainty handling improve compactness, camera recovery, and spatial understanding.

topics.name: Mathematical foundations and scientific learning
topics.summary: Theory papers develop formal tools for optimization, graph learning, variational systems, and scientific computation. Proofs and controlled numerical studies identify regimes where assumptions, regularization, or geometry determine stability.

topics.name: Fairness and social bias in language models
topics.summary: These studies measure social bias, fairness, human expertise, and group-sensitive behavior in language and recommendation systems. Audits show where aggregate performance hides unequal outcomes.

topics.name: Medical imaging and biomedical AI
topics.summary: Clinical work uses imaging, foundation models, radiomics, segmentation, and multimodal signals for diagnosis, treatment, and physiological prediction. The papers emphasize interpretability, transfer across sites, annotation limits, and robust endpoints.

topics.name: Anomaly detection and predictive maintenance
topics.summary: Anomaly and maintenance studies model rare failures in machines, networks, and industrial assets using residuals, robust features, and multimodal evidence. Validation stresses early warning, cross-condition transfer, and false-alarm cost.

topics.name: Multilingual NLP and machine translation
topics.summary: Multilingual work covers dialect robustness, cross-lingual retrieval, translation evaluation, and language-specific adaptation. Parallel or culturally grounded data reveal where shared representations help and where language-dependent behavior persists.

topics.name: Object detection, segmentation, and recognition
topics.summary: Vision systems address open-world recognition, semantic and instance segmentation, speech or image classification, and remote-sensing change detection. Prompting, pseudo-labels, prototype geometry, and continual adaptation reduce annotation demands.

topics.name: Structured NLP and knowledge extraction
topics.summary: Language systems extract fields, resolve references, generate structured answers, and evaluate confidence in specialized domains. Schema constraints, retrieval, and targeted prompting make outputs more useful for search and decision support.

topics.name: Causal inference and statistical learning
topics.summary: Causal and statistical papers estimate treatment effects, study calibration and misspecification, and model longitudinal outcomes. Counterfactual structure, state-space methods, and robust estimators separate association from decision-relevant variation.

topics.name: General machine learning methods
topics.summary: The remaining studies develop reusable learning tools for latent representations and structured optimization. Their analyses connect statistical assumptions, representation choices, and evaluation practice to model reliability.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and planning
topics.summary: Reinforcement-learning papers improve policy search, multi-agent planning, world-model control, and reward design. Simulators, hierarchical objectives, and safety constraints make exploration more efficient and behavior more predictable.
